Printable Christmas Stocking Patterns

ByErin Huffstetler Updated onOctober 9, 2026

Use these printable Christmas stocking patterns to sew your own stockings. There’s a pattern for a full-size stocking and another for a mini stocking.

Table of Contents
  • Printable Full-Size Christmas Stocking Pattern
  • Printable Mini Christmas Stocking Pattern

Printable Full-Size Christmas Stocking Pattern

Print Full-Size Christmas Stocking Pattern

This full-size Christmas stocking pattern makes a stocking that measures 17 inches long, and has a 7 1/2 inch opening. The pattern includes a stocking, a cuff and a loop to hang it.

Print Instructions: Before you hit print, check that your printer is set to “actual size” or “100 percent,” so the pattern prints full scale. Each page of the pattern has a 1-inch square in the top corner that you can use to double check that your pattern has printed the intended size.

Pattern Instructions: Cut out all the pieces of the pattern. Then, match up the lettered half circles to assemble the stocking and cuff patterns. Use tape to join everything.

Once your pattern is ready to go, follow these step-by-step instructions to make your stocking. In the tutorial, I show you how to make a full-size stocking out of an old quilt, but you can use any fabric you’d like.

How to Sew a Full-Size Christmas Stocking

Printable Mini Christmas Stocking Pattern

This mini Christmas stocking pattern makes a stocking that measures approximately 7.5 inches long and 3 inches wide at the opening. It’s the perfect size to wrap small gifts, a gift card or party favors. You can also use it to make Christmas stocking garland or ornaments for your tree.

Print Instructions: As with the full-size stocking, it’s important to check that your printer is set to “actual size” or “100 percent,” before you hit “print.”

Pattern Instructions: Just cut out the pattern pieces for the stocking, cuff and loop, and you’re ready to get to work on your mini stocking.

Print Mini Christmas Stocking Pattern

Here’s a step-by-step tutorial to walk you through the process of making your first mini Christmas stocking.

How to Sew a Mini Christmas Stocking
